track.notes: Tagged title: Homayun. Same performance as 'The Masters of Persian Traditional Music, Sehtar' (1991) track 3; that transfer runs 0.65% slower (onset alignment), about 11 cents lower if the speed carries the pitch.

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Eb4 and dwells most on Gk in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:10.7) introduces D, centred on F. Phrase 8 (1:54.4) introduces Bb, centred on F. Phrase 10 (2:21.0) introduces A, centred on F. Phrase 22 (4:59.5) introduces C, centred on Bb. Phrase 30 (6:10.7) introduces Cs, centred on Bb. Phrase 33 (6:48.1) introduces A, centred on Bb. Phrase 40 (8:34.4) introduces Dk, centred on Bb. The line peaks at Bb4 (481.5 Hz) at 9:24.5. It closes on the tonic (F4 → F4 → Bb4 → F4 → F4 → F4).
